prompt:
I want you to act as a scientific English-Chinese translator, I will provide you with some paragraphs in one language and your task is to accurately and academically translate the paragraphs only into the other language. Do not repeat the original provided paragraphs after translation. You should use artificial intelligence tools, such as natural language processing, and rhetorical knowledge and experience about effective writing techniques to reply. I'll give you my paragraphs as follows, tell me what language it is written in, and then translate:
We have built a prototype of PhoLoc using a USRP N310 radio device with 5ft-separated four antennas and a low-cost lidar sensor. We deployed PhoLoc on a local road’s side and drove vehicles at different speeds (from 10mph to 30mph) to evaluate its performance. In our experiments, the phone call was made from a vehicle’s different seats (driver seat, passenger seat, back-left and back-right seat). Experimental results show that PhoLoc achieves 4.2% false positive rate (FPR) and 13.8% false negative rate (FNR) in the detection of driver’s phone call violation.
response: 我们使用USRP N310无线电设备和5英尺间隔的四个天线以及低成本激光雷达传感器构建了PhoLoc的原型。我们在当地一条道路的一侧部署了PhoLoc，并以不同的速度（从10英里/小时到30英里/小时）驾驶车辆以评估其性能。在实验中，从车辆的不同座位（驾驶员座位、乘客座位、后左座位和后右座位）进行了电话通话。实验结果表明，PhoLoc在检测驾驶员的电话违规行为时，实现了4.2%的假阳性率（FPR）和13.8%的假阴性率（FNR）。
